select REVIEW_ID, R.PRODUCT_ID, REVIEWER_NO, REVIEWEE_NO, RATING, CONTENT, to_char(R.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as "CREATED_AT_STR", R.CREATED_AT, nvl(U.NICKNAME, '탈퇴한 회원') as "REVIEWER_NICKNAME", P.TITLE from REVIEWS R join USERS U on R.REVIEWER_NO = U.USER_NO join PRODUCTS P on R.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID where REVIEWEE_NO = #{userNo} order by CREATED_AT desc
offset #{offset} rows fetch next #{size} rows only
